decision.summary: Carry the beta11-e1 blind aggregate over to the re-bound Beta.11 candidate ec9224d (after PR #994); no new epoch and no blind run against it.
decision.departsFrom: docs/specs/blind-evaluation.md section 2 rule 2 (a new product change needs a new candidate identity and a new run)

knownDifferences.change: redact-secret#948 (PR #994): a provider-named high-signal credential variable no longer disqualifies generic-token, so an off-grammar value under the provider own variable is reported at the generic floors (redact at 16 bytes and entropy 3.0, else warn)
knownDifferences.effect: a policy change the beta11-e1 epoch did not measure: blind fixtures that put an off-grammar or near-miss value under a provider credential variable read silent at 1db8ff3 and generic-token at ec9224d; the carried false-alarm count (0/27) was measured under the old policy and says nothing about such controls

knownDifferences.change: redact-secret#993 (PR #994): placeholders, masks, elided displays, Make-escaped references, documented public keys and the Confluent key id are silent under every contextual name
knownDifferences.effect: can only remove generic-token findings; the carried leaked-span count could move only if a blind positive is one of these shapes

knownDifferences.change: redact-secret#990 (PR #992) layout classes, carried from the 8f97f14 record

merges.scope: CI, manifests, issue forms, conformance records, docs
#948 provider-named generic-token fallback, #993 non-secret value exclusions, #902 linear PII context association (output byte-identical), #896 scoped checks (scripts only)

lone CR as a line end for every line-reading detector (LF and CRLF unchanged), including the Twilio CLI table
